posts.text:
Happy Labor Day, Michigan!
 
Since 1936, Michigan has been home to the greatest labor leaders in the nation. Today, our country is built on their hard work and sacrifice.
 
In 2023, I was proud to honor this legacy by becoming the first state to repeal a right to work law. https://t.co/fKgmFB1zEf

I'm thankful that Dr. Acton and her family are safe after being attacked earlier today at the Canfield Fair. I'm hoping for the speedy recovery of those injured.

We must come together and reject political violence in all forms. It has no place in our nation -- not now, not ever.
